# Rōmy

> Rōmy is an AI-powered donor intelligence and prospect research platform that helps small nonprofits find new major donors at a fraction of the cost of enterprise wealth screening tools.

Rōmy is a donor intelligence platform built for small nonprofit teams. It uses AI-powered prospect research to surface wealth indicators, giving histories, and affinity signals — then distills them into actionable donor profiles. Rōmy is built as a purpose-built alternative to enterprise wealth screening platforms such as DonorSearch, iWave, and WealthEngine, at a fraction of the cost.

## Features

- Donor Discovery: AI-powered prospect research with wealth indicators, giving history, and affinity signals
- Fraction of the Cost: No enterprise contracts or per-seat licensing — donor intelligence at a price built for small nonprofits (from $290/year, vs. $15,000–$50,000/year for legacy platforms)
- Ready to Act On: Every prospect comes with connection points, giving capacity, and outreach angles

## Benchmarks

On PIF-Bench (Prospect Intelligence Fidelity Benchmark), an open benchmark comparing donor-research accuracy across AI systems, Rōmy scored 94.6 versus Claude (92.2), ChatGPT (79.9), and Gemini (76.0). Full methodology and results: https://getromy.app/labs
